scope: Disposable single-node Replica Set; real localhost HTTP/JWT and production query pipeline. Golden bytes seeded directly for query timing (B3 import correctness is integration/E2E). Synthetic 500k/20 stations at 1-minute cadence. Three sequential calls/case; first call included, no load/SLA claim. Sampled Node process includes HTTP client and validation, excludes mongod; not an isolated backend peak. No model inference or training.
